description: GCT USB4085-GF-A right-angle USB-C receptacle, 48 V DC and 5 A collective VBUS rating. GCT USB4085 Rev B pages 1-2 document contacts and recommended PCB layout; the PD recipe uses CC and power only.
name: gct-usb4085
watch_out_for: Manufacturer's collective 5 A connector rating is not a board-level current guarantee. The imported four shell slots share S1; all 16 signal-hole positions and drills match GCT Rev B page 2. Signal lands are enlarged from 0.650 to 0.661 mm to exceed the 0.13 mm fabrication annular-ring floor; the courtyard includes the body outline and shell lands with at least 0.2 mm clearance. USB data and SBU are unused by the PD receptacle recipe.
